title: Inpatient Hospice Patients who have Sought ElderShield Claims
what_it_is: Inpatient Hospice Patients who have Sought ElderShield Claims

sections.label: Severe disability scheme claim processing
sections.summary: Severe disability scheme claims are processed in a median of 10 working days, with payouts disbursed the month after approval and backdated to the disability assessment date.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Currently, the median time for processing all severe disability scheme claims applications is 10 working days.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Payouts are disbursed in the month after application approval and will include payouts for prior months between date of disability assessment and approval date.

sections.label: Expediting assessments for terminally ill
sections.summary: MOH is working with AIC to improve access to severe disability assessors for hospice patients and to expand home assessment access and house-call assessors.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan Wu Meng (Jurong)
sentences.text: Can I ask the Senior Parliamentary Secretary, can MOH do a review of existing policies to see how assessments and outcomes can be expedited for terminally ill Singaporeans who do not have much time left?

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: We recognise that requiring two Resident Assessment Forms six months apart is not very applicable to the patients in hospices.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: For patients in the inpatient hospice setting, the best assessment arrangement is to use the severe disability assessment, but we acknowledge the issue that Dr Tan's resident faced.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: In that particular case, the ElderShield application was eventually approved based on the doctor's memo.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: In following up with Dr Tan's feedback, MOH is working with AIC to improve access to severe disability assessors.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: In particular, AIC will work with inpatient hospices to actively link them up with available severe disability assessors.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: To further enhance this, we are also looking at enhancing access to severe disability assessments at home for patients who may be less mobile.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: We will continue to expand our pool of house-call assessors who are currently in the number of about 230.
